name: app-real-estate-app-on-terracotta-leather-sofa
title: Cream real-estate app photographed leaning on a terracotta leather cushion
whatItIs: A gold-framed phone leaning on a quilted terracotta leather sofa in soft light. The screen is cream with a greeting, a row of round property avatars, a search field and two property cards with photos.
whatItMeans: Cosy, warm and upscale; the material and colour of the setting match the interface palette.
techniques: Pick a real scene whose colour matches the UI (terracotta and cream).
Use round photo avatars as a horizontal filter.
Keep the UI light with subtle borders and big photo cards.
Use natural side lighting and shallow depth.

vocabulary.definition: Choosing a mockup setting that mirrors the UI palette.
A row of circular images acting as category filters.
A card showing a listing photo and key facts.
